# updawg_group (Data Source)

A host group, by name. Needs the token scope `read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A group made in the portal.
data "updawg_group" "db" {
  name = "db"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The group's name.

### Optional

- `org` (String) The organization's slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What it is for.
- `id` (String) `grp_…`.
- `label_selector` (Map of String) The labels that put a host in it.
- `resolved_hosts` (Number) How many hosts it holds now.
